name: 16 Years Later!
source:
A man of great fate returns home to his three stepdaughters after 16 years in prison. The girls have grown up. The man soon realizes that he feels more for the girls than paternal love.

Be kind or be strict. It's up to you to get the girls ...

[From [url=https://wetdreamwalker.itch.io/16-years-later-episode-5]Itch.io[/url]]
